== Biography ==
John Glasgow lived in Richland Township, Belmont County, Ohio. The 1860 census records him as John Glassga, aged 86, born in Ireland, with Elizabeth, 61, born Maryland, and [[Glasgow-2601|Daniel E Glasgow]], 24, a farmer born in Ohio.<ref name="Richland1860">1860 United States census, Ohio, Belmont County, Richland Township, p.90, dwelling 626/family 634, lines 26–28, enumerated 7 July 1860; NARA M653, DGS005170527 image 00095. [https://search.findmypast.co.uk/record?id=USC%2F1860%2F005170527%2F00095&parentid=USC%2F1860%2F0000708706126 Original image] and [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=USC%2F1860%2F0000708706126 Findmypast transcript USC/1860/0000708706126], inspected 23 October 2026. The schedule has no relationship column.</ref> His age suggests birth about 1774. His East Richland Cemetery monument records his death on 8 January 1864, in his 92nd year, implying an earlier birth about 1772–1773.<ref name="RichlandStone">Find a Grave, memorial 143055352, [https://www.findagrave.com/memorial/143055352/john-glasgow John Glasgow Sr.], East Richland Cemetery, Richland Township, Belmont County, Ohio; inscribed-face photograph by MelissaMae, 11 May 2018, [https://images.findagrave.com/photos/2018/130/143055352_d589b586-8c38-4a35-b84f-f4f832903ea8.jpeg photograph], inspected 23 October 2026. The monument’s age and modern typed birth fields disagree.</ref> His exact birth date and parents remain unknown.

Isabel Glenn ([[Glenn-5657]]) and Elizabeth Blocher ([[Blocher-374]]) are attached as wives, and [[Glasgow-2927|John Glasgow Jr]] and [[Glasgow-2601|Daniel E Glasgow]] as sons. The retained marriage indexes name Isabella Glenn in 1827 and Elizabeth Neff in 1831; these dates and the Glenn identities need separate reconciliation with the reported older son’s 1805 birth. The 1860 household does not resolve the earlier marriages.

== Research Notes ==
=== Conflicting Scottish birth ===

The reported 26 November 1784 birth at Bathgate conflicts with the original 1860 census age and Irish birthplace, and with the monument’s reported age. Find a Grave repeats 1784/Bathgate in its typed fields but says 92 in its narrative. A Wiston and Roberton baptism index gives a John Glasgow born 26 November 1784, baptised 30 November 1784, son of James Glasgow, residence “?Shield”.<ref name="Wiston1784">Findmypast, Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F4108115 John Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BAP/4108115], Wiston and Roberton, Lanarkshire; OPR 660/1, item 1. Transcript inspected 23 October 2026; original register not inspected.</ref> The shared birthday could reflect a copied identification; its provenance is unknown. It does not outweigh the older Irish-born Ohio adult’s evidence. No father is assigned from that baptism or from the separate Bathgate family. [[Glasgow-1460|John of Canongate]] remains a separately assessed childhood comparison, not an identification established here.

Seek earlier Ohio census, naturalisation or church evidence naming an Irish locality or relative, and establish the source of the modern Scottish birth claim.
